story.label: N° 002 — Heritage
story.title:
Heritage,
*reimagined*
as craft.
story.lead: Long ago, in a small kitchen lit by lanterns, a grandmother folded saffron into milk and called it medicine. We started there.
story.body: We treat the dining room like a stage and the kitchen like a studio — sourcing heirloom spices, refining technique, and pairing every plate with intention. The result is Indian cuisine that feels familiar yet entirely new — slow, considered, and quietly indulgent.
story.pullquote: Every dish is a love letter — folded by hand, sealed in flame, opened at the table.

cocktails.label: N° 004 — The Bar Program
cocktails.title:
Spirits, *spice*,
slow ritual.
cocktails.body: Our cocktails are built like dishes — layered, balanced, and rooted in the Indian pantry. Cardamom. Tamarind. Saffron. Smoke.
cocktails.feature_note: An aged Campari kissed with date-tamarind cordial, finished with a cardamom oil mist.
cocktails.feature_method: Stirred · Served on a single rock

ambience.label: N° 006 — Ambience
ambience.title:
A room
lit by *flame*
and quiet music.
ambience.body: Soft lighting. Brushed brass. Velvet banquettes built for slow conversation. Outside, a heated patio for warm evenings under cedar.
ambience.interior_caption: Velvet banquettes, brass fixtures, candlelight tuned to the hour.
ambience.patio_caption: Heated, hedge-private, lit by hanging lanterns and West-Coast dusk.
ambience.music_caption: A nightly score curated by hand — analog warmth, sub-bass restraint.

about_page.title:
A laboratory
for *Indian* flavour.
about_page.lead: Founded by a chef and a sommelier with a shared love for the subcontinent's pantry — and a romance with the West Coast.
about_page.philosophy: We start every dish with a single question: what does this spice want to be? Then we test, taste, and refine until the answer is undeniable.
